scope: personal-story exits, fallen protagonist wins, defeat penalty, enemy target spread, equipment screen, item wording and icons

checks.name: "prepare later" in a personal mission ends the story and frees the player
a save left on the finished story gate opens with the story closed

evidence.blockedBefore: 현재 이야기와 전투를 마친 뒤 제목 화면으로 돌아갈 수 있습니다.

checks.name: the protagonist falling does not lose a battle the companions win
a defeat costs 10% of Mora and locks actions for 60 real seconds
retrying a story battle keeps the Mora lost to the defeat
damaged or invalid defeat records are refused on load
enemies spread their first target instead of always hitting the weakest ally
leaving the party takes that companion's gear back to the bag
player-facing wording for the hood and the field pack

evidence.pack: 파티원 중 한 명만 메고 있어도 전투 전에 준비할 수 있는 전투 도구가 2종에서 3종으로 늘어납니다. 음식과 일반 소모품은 여전히 전투 중에 쓸 수 없습니다.

checks.name: item icons: the reworked textures ship and match their hashes
equipment screen, party notice and defeat timer are wired (source)
